prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a hit while turning left claim. Injury: back strain. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1278; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Reviewed the first notice of loss for a left-turn collision at an intersection. Insured reports the other vehicle came through on the opposing green while the insured was turning. Police report requested. Photos of both vehicles on file.

Entry 2: Spoke with the insured's statement recorded. Insured states they checked for oncoming traffic and proceeded on a gap. Insured admits the other vehicle may have been close but was not able to confirm speed. Coverage confirmed under liability policy, no coverage issues noted.

Entry 3: Claimant reports lower back strain from the impact and has retained counsel. All further contact to be routed through claimant's attorney. Medical authorization requested from counsel. Request for prior treatment records sent to counsel for review.

Entry 4: Received a letter of representation from claimant's attorney. Demand package expected within the timeframe under review. Independent medical examination being scheduled through the attorney's office. Reserve reviewed and adjusted to reflect the back strain and ongoing treatment.

Entry 5: Liability assessment updated. Based on the police report and both statements, fault appears to be shared, with the insured carrying the greater share for failing to yield on the left turn. Counsel notified of the preliminary position. File remains open pending medical records and the demand.
